theorem CategoryGame.exists_jointPlay.{u} {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] (σ : CategoryGame.FirstStrategy X)
  (τ : CategoryGame.SecondStrategy X) :
  Exists fun a =>
    Exists fun b =>
      And (∀ (n : Nat), Eq (a n) (CategoryGame.FirstStrategy.move σ (CategoryGame.history X b n)))
        (And (∀ (n : Nat), Eq (b n) (CategoryGame.SecondStrategy.move τ (a n) (CategoryGame.history X a n)))
          (And (CategoryGame.FollowsFirst X σ b)
            (And (CategoryGame.FollowsSecond X τ a)
              (∀ (n : Nat),
                And (LE.le (Subtype.val (b n)) (Subtype.val (a n)))
                  (LE.le (Subtype.val (a (HAdd.hAdd n 1))) (Subtype.val (b n)))))))
audit_declarations.name: CategoryGame.exists_jointPlay
